ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a very low ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, which are confined primarily to the distal tips and extreme edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large contiguous low-intensity dark region covers >98% of the visible ventral area. Distinct high-contrast white patchy blobs and mottling are localized strictly at the far-left and far-right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central notch exhibits a distinct V-shape with an obtuse interior pixel angle and moderate vertical depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, manifesting as irregular pixel-level peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a smooth concave sweep that terminates in sharp, upward-pointing convex curves at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized, high-intensity circular pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, indicating barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct protrusive biological growths (barnacle colonies) are visible on the distal tips and the upper margins of both lobes.
